svg.title: Truncation and round-off against a known solution
svg.desc: Panel a: logistic growth with its closed-form solution, with eight fixed steps of fourth-order Runge-Kutta marked. Panel b: absolute error at the final time against the number of steps, in float64 and float32. Error falls as the fourth power of the step until round-off dominates; float32 reaches its floor near one part in ten million after about forty steps and the error then grows with the step count, while float64 reaches its floor near one part in ten to the fifteenth. One method on one problem with a known solution; errors of exactly zero are drawn at the axis floor.
svg.title: Truncation and round-off against a known solution
